content.title: Sports in Minnesota
content.text: Every major professional sport is represented in Minnesota, from the Timberwolves, Frost and Twins to the Wild, Lynx and United FC. No matter the season, you can catch a game at some of the country's top arenas and stadiums. (Even the University of Minnesota has a world-class home for its Big Ten games.) Whether you're a diehard or fair-weather fan, our home teams are eager to have you in their stands. Root, Root, Root for the Home Team Work It St Croix Baseball ClubStillwaterVintage baseball league with games throughout the valley. The Washington County Historical Society’s vintage base ball club, the St. Croixs, wear 1860s uniforms and play by 1860s rules. They are unique in bringing a piece of the past to the present for people to view. Join the fun cheering the vintage baseball team that uses the 1860 "New York Rules" game. Here comes the Minnesota Frost. Minnesota Frost celebrates hockey’s fierceness and beauty, a timeless Minnesota tradition, bridging generations.
